  ----------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
              Barjack War             

             **Location**                                 [Badlands](/wiki/Badlands "Badlands")\
                                             [Factory Farms]{.new title="Factory Farm (page does not exist)"
                                       uncrawlable-url="L3dpa2kvRmFjdG9yeV9GYXJtP2FjdGlvbj1lZGl0JnJlZGxpbms9MQ=="}\
                                              [Factory Railroad](/wiki/Factory_Railroad "Factory Railroad")\
                                                         [Scrapyard](/wiki/Scrapyard "Scrapyard")

              **Outcome**                  [Barjack](/wiki/Barjack "Barjack") disbanded as a conventional army\
                                                             Death of [Den](/wiki/Den "Den")\
                                                            Fall of the [Ground Investigation
                                         Bureau](/wiki/Ground_Investigation_Bureau "Ground Investigation Bureau")

       **Affiliations involved**                           [Barjack](/wiki/Barjack "Barjack")\
                                                           [Factory](/wiki/Factory "Factory")\
                                                                  [Ground Investigation
                                         Bureau](/wiki/Ground_Investigation_Bureau "Ground Investigation Bureau")
  ----------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The **Barjack War** was a large scale revolt led by
[Den](/wiki/Den "Den") against
[Tiphares](/wiki/Tiphares "Tiphares"){.mw-redirect} and its ground
forces in the form of the [Factory
Army](/wiki/Factory_Army "Factory Army") and later the
[TUNED](/wiki/TUNED "TUNED") that lasted from ES 585 to ES 590.
